name: bot-menu-grpc
title: Bot menu operations over gRPC
description: Owner-confirmed semantics (2026-11-04): a USER account interacts with a bot's menu inside that bot's private chat (option A2) — NOT bot-account menu CRUD. Deliverable now: research report (done) + a thin, no-new-dependency design that reuses go-tdlib on the existing user session (resolve bot chat, read bot command menu, read/click inline callback buttons, send /command). WebApp menus out of scope. Research is the dominant phase; implementation requires owner go-ahead.
scope: LOOP P2 implementation. Owner semantics: a USER account interacts with a bot's menu inside the bot's private chat (option A2), NOT bot-account menu CRUD. No bot token, no second session, no new dependency, no ruleset change; reuse go-tdlib on the existing user session. Agreed v1: 5 additive FacadeGRPC RPCs — ResolveBot, GetBotInfo, GetInlineMenu, ClickCallbackButton, SendBotCommand; no reply fetching/polling/stream; WebApp menus out of scope. Design gate PASSED round 2 (D1-D8 met, design_sha256 ad40f183…); implementer at work. Merge/publish gated on explicit owner approval.
